Read the current UI tree or take a screenshot. Paused while locked.
Tap, swipe, press keys and enter text in the focused field.
Shizuku provides screenshots and keys. Screen reading and input require Shizuku or the optional accessibility service below; screenshots require Shizuku.
Connected · UI reading, taps and Unicode input
Optional: enable Unicode input and more reliable UI reading.

Only when Android device access and its corresponding toggles are enabled, allows this App’s local terminal tools to read the current UI, tap and enter text. Does not run tasks automatically, access password fields or operate while locked.

Local terminals, extensions and agent tools within this App can read device and App state. Screen reading and input require separate toggles below. Uses a private local socket, with no LAN listener. Turn it off here or in the notification at any time. Access must be enabled again after the App process restarts.

Open a new terminal to use android-device; existing terminals can run /manager/bin/android-device. Ask dsh to read android-device --help and invoke it with its terminal tool. Coordinates use the screen pixels returned by info. Screenshots are resized; convert using screenWidth / screenHeight.

Ubuntu and dsh can read and write this shared directory. Use the buttons below to exchange Android files; imports are limited to 512 MB each. Other apps’ private data is not exposed. Uninstalling this App deletes these files.
